_about: Which spec files each Playwright project runs, read by playwright.config.ts and by scripts/e2e-shard.mjs, which deals the chromium project's files out to CI runners. `walkthrough` is a pattern of file names; the rest are lists of them. The chromium project runs every other spec file. `seconds` is how long each chromium file took on a CI runner with one worker, from the list reporter's lines in a CI log, rounded (CI run 43635015670, November 2026; zone-tool.spec.ts was new then and is a guess; the three building-lod files are from a local run in the development container, which draws in software like a CI runner). The shard script balances the runners by it, so a file that gets much slower or much faster should have its number brought up to date. A file not listed counts as `defaultSeconds`.
